skills.name: analyze-large-result-diff
skills.title: Analyze Large Result Diff
skills.description: Reduce a very large CVAR, GCVAR, risk, or regression comparison CSV into compact evidence by scanning only required gap/key columns first, selecting material impacts by threshold and Pareto coverage, enriching only selected rows, and returning patterns instead of raw data to the LLM.

examples.title: CVAR with production defaults
examples.command: skillhub run analyze-large-result-diff -- --profile cvar --input cvar.csv --output out/cvar

examples.title: CVAR with 80 percent impact coverage
examples.command: skillhub run analyze-large-result-diff -- --profile cvar --input cvar.csv --output out/cvar --coverage 0.8

examples.title: GCVAR with an overridden threshold
examples.command: skillhub run analyze-large-result-diff -- --profile gcvar --input gcvar.csv --output out/gcvar --threshold "EepeInEur Gap=25000"

skills.latest_changelog:

skills.name: backtesting-drilldown

skills.description: Use compact upstream CVAR or GCVAR evidence to filter a much larger CCR backtesting comparison CSV early, derive DealId from the TRD segment of AggregationLevel when necessary, rank material deal contributors by Pareto coverage, and return only compact evidence.

examples.title: Drill CVAR impact into backtesting deals
examples.command: skillhub run backtesting-drilldown -- --input backtesting.csv --evidence cvar-analysis/summary.json --output bt-analysis

examples.title: Use 80 percent deal coverage
examples.command: skillhub run backtesting-drilldown -- --input backtesting.csv --evidence cvar-analysis/summary.json --output bt-analysis --coverage 0.8

skills.name: compare-result-snapshots
skills.title: Compare Result Snapshots
skills.description: Compare two CSV result snapshots deterministically, identify changed aggregate metrics, missing or new keys, and the largest row-level movers. Use for regression outputs, risk metrics, benchmarks, prices, latency, PnL or any before/after tabular result before asking the model to explain causes.

examples.title: Compare two CCR snapshots
examples.command: python scripts/compare_results.py --before before.csv --after after.csv --keys counterparty,date --metrics EEPE,EPE --output analysis

skills.name: investigate-metric-jump

examples.title: Correlate result and code changes
examples.command: python scripts/build_investigation_brief.py --comparison analysis/comparison.json --candidates release-analysis/candidates.json --metric EEPE --output investigation.md

skills.name: prepare-ccr-release-evidence
skills.title: Prepare CCR Release Evidence
skills.description: Orchestrate the deterministic data-reduction part of CCR release validation: reduce CVAR and GCVAR compare CSVs, drill only impacted Legal Entities into huge backtesting CSVs, build one compact LLM handoff, and optionally prefetch reusable release-PR forensic candidates.

examples.title: Prepare CVAR and GCVAR evidence
examples.command: skillhub run prepare-ccr-release-evidence -- --cvar cvar.csv --cvar-backtesting cvar-bt.csv --gcvar gcvar.csv --gcvar-backtesting gcvar-bt.csv --prod-ref release/26.9 --candidate-ref release/26.10 --output out/ccr-release

examples.title: Prepare evidence and prefetch candidate PRs
examples.command: skillhub run prepare-ccr-release-evidence -- --cvar cvar.csv --gcvar gcvar.csv --prod-ref release/26.9 --candidate-ref release/26.10 --repo OWNER/REPO --with-prs --output out/ccr-release

skills.name: release-pr-forensics
skills.title: Release PR Forensics
skills.description: Investigate regressions and metric impacts by retrieving the pull requests and direct commits that entered a release, a Git ref/commit interval, or a date window; rank evidence-backed candidate PRs; then inspect selective high-information patches before escalating to full diffs. Use when a release, build, result or metric became bad and you need to identify the code changes worth testing.

examples.title: Investigate a release
examples.command: python scripts/investigate.py --repo OWNER/REPO --release release/26.10 --query "EEPE jump" --output release-analysis

examples.title: Investigate two commits
examples.command: python scripts/investigate.py --repo OWNER/REPO --base GOOD_SHA --head BAD_SHA --query "latency regression" --output release-analysis

examples.title: Investigate a date window
examples.command: python scripts/investigate.py --repo OWNER/REPO --from-date 2026-09-15 --to-date 2026-09-22 --base-branch main --query "metric jump" --output release-analysis

workflows.name: CCR Release Validation
workflows.description: Multi-agent workflow for validating a candidate CCR release against production using CVAR and GCVAR compare-job evidence, targeted deal-level backtesting, and reusable PR/code forensics when material impacts require explanation.
trigger_examples: Validate candidate release release/26.10 against production release/26.9.
Validate the CCR release using the CVAR and GCVAR compare-job outputs and explain material regressions.

agents.role: Reduce CVAR compare output, detect material impacts/patterns, and drill impacted Legal Entities into backtesting deals.
Reduce GCVAR compare output, detect material impacts/patterns, and drill impacted Legal Entities into backtesting deals.
Combine compact validator evidence, explain shared/isolated patterns, and use reusable PR forensics when code-level investigation is justified.

execution.note: Deterministic fast reduction. Raw CSVs stay outside LLM context.

operating_rules: Raw huge CSV files are local tool inputs only and never LLM context.
The strict materiality rule is abs(gap) > 10000; exactly 10000 is not material.
Coverage is calculated independently per metric from absolute material movement; MTF00 and EEPE units are never mixed.
Backtesting is filtered first by impacted LegalEntity; its AggregationLevel is deal-grained and DealId is derived from the TRD segment when necessary.
PR ranking is evidence for investigation, not proof of causality.

Mtf00Gap materiality is 10000 in the row currency. When multiple currencies are present, Pareto coverage is computed independently per currency; native EUR/USD amounts are never summed for concentration statistics.
EepeInEurGap is EUR-denominated and Pareto coverage is global across the file.

The compare schema contains useful secondary diagnostics (RWA gap/ratio, EEPE gap/ratio, EffectiveMaturity and RiskWeightedExposureFactor Ref/Test changes, CashFlowType/Currency result flags). These are explanation clues, not primary materiality triggers.
notes: The deterministic CVAR/GCVAR/backtesting data plane is calibrated to the provided real compare-file screenshots.
Full production approval still benefits from a sanitized real CSV sample and one historical known regression to verify exact values, edge cases and throughput.
Multi-agent automatic handoff depends on the GitHub Copilot environment; the same workflow can be executed today with explicit validator then synthesizer handoff.

agents.name: ccr-cvar-release-validator
agents.description: Specialized CCR agent that validates the CVAR side of a candidate release by reducing the large CVAR comparison, selecting the largest material MTF00/EEPE impacts, detecting patterns across Ref/Test columns and business dimensions, then drilling only impacted Legal Entities into backtesting deal evidence.

agents.name: ccr-gcvar-release-validator
agents.description: Specialized CCR agent that validates the GCVAR side of a candidate release using the same real compare-file schema and materiality policy as CVAR, then drills impacted Legal Entities into backtesting deal evidence.

agents.name: ccr-release-validation-synthesizer
agents.description: CCR workflow synthesis/root-cause agent that combines compact CVAR and GCVAR validator evidence, identifies shared/isolated release impacts, invokes reusable PR forensics when justified, and produces an evidence-backed release-validation investigation brief.
